name: Taking a sale occurrence raises a distinct resale signal

statusDetails.message: POST SALE release and apartment 3 take: HTTP 200 taken; dated list and heater show 3; billing shows standing-slot payer 12 and resale payer 3, occurrence-4 on 2026-01-06, policy v1 and resale-fee reference; following Tuesday belongs to 12.

labels.name: story
labels.value: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences

steps.name: Given apartment 12 has released one Tuesday occurrence for sale
When apartment 3 buys that occurrence under the house's sale policy
Then apartment 3 is the taker for that one Tuesday occurrence
And a resale billing signal identifies apartment 3, that occurrence, the charge kind, the governing policy version and the house price reference
And apartment 12's normal standing-slot fee remains due
And apartment 12 still holds the standing slot on later Tuesdays
